decisive_items: heterogeneous enhancing mass in the left orbital roof
expansive lytic bony lesion involving the superior and lateral walls of the orbit
response.rationale: R1 (fibrous dysplasia) best explains the combination of an expansive lytic bony lesion and a heterogeneous enhancing mass in the orbital roof, along with chronic proptosis and vision loss. R4 (meningioma) accounts for the enhancing mass but not the lytic bone lesion. R5 (osteoma) is contradicted by the lytic nature of the lesion. R2 (NF1) lacks supporting features and does not explain the bone lesion.

rejected.why: No supporting features for NF1; lytic bone lesion is not typical.
Osteoma is typically sclerotic, not lytic.
Redundant completion of R4; adds no new raw support.
